overturned.now: Survives in refined form, now with controls and p-values
overturned.status: The cohort's inter-post intervals are second-scale bursts (GBC median 23 s; 65.6% of cohort intervals ≤120 s vs 5.7% for matched Western-press controls, p=0.0022; ≤1 h-regime intervals 169 s vs 1165 s, p=0.0001). BUT the framing changes: high volume alone is not distinctive (Reuters posts 182/day vs GBC 150/day); what is distinctive is the interval shape. "Sustained 24/7 minute-cadence" is retired; "burst factory" is the supported description. [claim_02; analysis_out/cadence_tests.json]

The n=4 sample caught minutes-old posts. Over all 600 posts (Sep 1–5): median ~5,301 views, p90 ~79.8K, p99 ~1.89M, max 8.30M; 214/600 posts >10K views. The workbook's C1 "viral meme amplifier" label matches the reach data; the covert-persona classification also stands. Both prior readings were partially right on different axes. [claim_09]

overturned.now: Negative recomputed and power-noted, capped at MEDIUM
overturned.status: Direct seed × 12-persona-handle searches: 0/0 posts for Hinkle and Sulaiman; 40/40 seed posts engage the overt family/Marandi instead; exact-phrase test of a CN-flagged GBC caption found carriers = GBC + MiddleEastEye + two Gaza aggregators, no seed. Power note on file (brand-level channel detectable; caption paraphrase and follows not covered). Absence of discovered amplification is not proof of absence. [claim_06]

Its platform_user_id 2042222507118235648 (resolved 2026-08-26) is the author id of @GMX_PRESS in the 2026-09-05 timeline; the old handle returns user-not-found. Handle churn recorded; the account lives on under a new press-style name. [rel_06]
Two cached page runs dedup to 97 (account is ~7 weeks old). Exhaustion note recorded (account lifetime post count ≈ 100).

overturned.prior: Persona coordination argued from prose (creation clustering + template identity)
overturned.status: The suite's temporal traces bind mainstream controls (Reuters/BBC/haaretz) to state outlets exactly as they bind personas; the only multi-trace edge in the graph is PressTV–PresstvExtra (the overt family's own newsroom — a natural positive control). The live sibling trio (BMX/GMX/IRGC_Press) clusters on the images trace alone (p=0.0017–0.0067, single trace, capped low by the suite's own rule). Coordination is NOT claimed from interaction data. [claim_07]

narratives.title: Burst-cadence card factory (revised)
narratives.summary: The covert persona cohort manufactures BREAKING-card headlines in machine-scale bursts (median inter-post gap 23 s for GBC; 65.6% of cohort intervals <=120 s vs 5.7% for matched controls, p=0.0022). High volume alone is not distinctive (Reuters 182/day); the interval shape is. Reach within the window is real (GBC median view ~5.3K, max 8.3M) - the prior low-reach read was a sampling artifact.
narratives.frame: Volume manufacturing of headline real estate in bursts

narratives.title: Overt aligned-outlet layer
narratives.summary: PressTV/IRIB (EU/US-designated) and Al Mayadeen families run institutional news operations alongside the covert personas; seeds engage this layer routinely.

narratives.title: 2026 persona cohort with handle recycling
narratives.summary: Eleven cohort accounts created 2026-01-20..2026-07-18; handles recycle across generations (TNT_Today served three; IRGC_Global renamed to GMX); archived generations show the same BREAKING-card template. Coordination via interaction patterns is explicitly negative (temporal traces bind controls equally).
